version.approval_notes: Requires the KeyHarbor desktop program (macOS) with its native messaging host (keyharbor browser install-host). Build from the attached source: cd integrations/browser-extension && npm ci && npm run package (Node 22). The add-on talks only to the local native host.

summary.en-US: Hand a site's login to a KeyHarbor agent session, and fill or save logins from the KeyHarbor vault on this Mac.
